# Synthetic costing references

These six cases and cent-exact expected values originate from Francesco's
29 September 2026 Discord costing contribution, `skill.zip` SHA-256
`c66eaee443bac63fd5f94ceeca7a0b3a64c84ecaba95a8e4f5e7db6b62ee2bca`.
They are fictional, not client records or market benchmarks.

The reference Node engine passed 85 tests. Freshly generated outputs were checked
against 96 independent Python Fraction comparisons before these expected values
were retained. The Python integration must preserve these results without importing
or executing the contributor's code at runtime. Tests additionally exercise
selected-method completeness, real archive binding and stale-review rejection.
